entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. Um, yes, I think I need to... to return something? It's the VeloBand Pulse monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the band or more of a preference?

A fault? I don't... I don't think so. It turns on. It's just... I'm not sure. The website was a little overwhelming, and it's not really what I expected. I just don't think I'll use it. Can't you just help me?
I understand completely. It's no problem at all. Let me just pull up your order details and review the return eligibility. Can I have your order number, please?
Thank you. I see the order here. It looks like the VeloBand Pulse was delivered to you on December 15th, which was 28 days ago. Let me just check our policy...
Oh, is that bad? Am I too late? I get so confused by these things.

Not at all! You're perfectly fine. I'm looking at our internal knowledge base right now, and the VeloFit return policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 28, you are well within that window. I can process this return for you immediately.
Wait, really? Ninety days? Oh, that's such a relief! I was so worried I'd be stuck with it. Thank you!

You are very welcome. I've just initiated the return. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on your account now. Simply print it out, place the band back in its original packaging, and drop it off at the post office. Your refund will be processed once we receive the item.
That's wonderful. Thank you so much for your help, Isaac.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Glad to hear it. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
